label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/sql-injection): alert-TP — The variable q is constructed by concatenating user-supplied input param (derived from request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest')) directly into a SQL UPDATE statement. Although the SQL string is stored in the request attribute ('pendingSql') rather than executed immediately in this method, the resolved sink value q is fully attacker-controlled and lacks sanitization or parameterization. This constitutes a vulnerable dynamic SQL construction pattern that enables SQL injection if the stored string is subsequently executed.

evidence.note: User input param is extracted and concatenated into SQL string q without sanitization
